<noinclude>
A shortcut for [[Template:TranslationDef | <code><nowiki>{{TranslationDef}}</nowiki></code>]] used in [[Data:WikiTranslations]].
== Usage ==
<pre><nowiki>
{{ WikiTranslation
| subtype = common          <!-- the group this belongs to -->
| target_id = wiki_might    <!-- the id in the Translation Cargo table -->
| en = Might                <!-- a comment about what the translation means in English -->
| name = Force              <!-- the actual translation -->
}}
</nowiki></pre>
<b style='color:#c8b36c'>wiki_might</b>: <b style='color:#2ea821'>Might</b> = <b style='color:#47adf2'>Force</b>
</noinclude><includeonly>{{#cargo_store:_table=Translation
| target_id = {{{target_id|}}}
| type = wiki
| subtype = {{{subtype|}}}
| variant = {{{variant|}}}
| language = {{#titleparts: {{SUBPAGENAME}} | 1 | 2}}
| name = {{{name|}}}
| description = {{{description|}}}
| bonus_description = {{{bonus_description|}}}
}}<b style='color:#c8b36c'>{{{target_id|}}}</b>: <b style='color:#2ea821'>{{{en|}}}</b> = <b style='color:peru'>{{{name|}}}</b>
</includeonly>
